heading: Thursday, May 14, 2026
topLine: arXiv to ban authors for a year over unchecked LLM-generated content.

items.headline: arXiv to ban authors for a year over unchecked LLM-generated content
items.summary: arXiv computer-science section chair Thomas Dietterich announced that authors face a one-year ban when there is "incontrovertible evidence" of unchecked LLM output, such as hallucinated references. Afterwards, their submissions must first be accepted by a peer-reviewed venue. The rule does not ban AI use, and authors remain responsible for their content.
